title: Rack holder for prep ziplock bags
text: Rack holder for prep ziplock bags. Ok.  If you do prep for the freezer or fridge - you need these.  I cannot believe I have waited all these years to try them.  It can be so stressful to get whatever you're preparing into the bag!  I am so so happy with these.  They are easily adjustable for the size of the bag.  So easy to use.  I can't be without them now.  They are plastic - time will tell how long they last.  You get a set of 4. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
